name: group-ml1m
_hybrid_note: Weights fitted in M3 by scripts/sweep_weights.py on a validation split nested inside train. The group layer uses the same scorer the individual evaluation reported on, so a difference in the group results is attributable to the group layer.
_mode_fit_note: Fitted by scripts/sweep_modes.py on validation groups nested inside train; the test groups were not seen. One deliberate override: the unconstrained fit chose tau_veto=0.0 for fair_rotation, which maximises proxy_min by removing the veto and enlarging the candidate pool. That trades a product guarantee -- no member sits through a track they strongly object to -- for a proxy metric, so tau is held at 0.35. The unconstrained result is recorded in eval/results/mode-sweep.json.
_repetition_note: MovieLens has no artist, so the repetition axis is the film's primary genre. With only 18 genres, max_artist_share is high for every strategy and is not comparable to the music table's value -- there it counts one artist among thousands.
